name: CC-Bench-trajectories
description:
CC-Bench Trajectories Overview
	

To evaluate GLM-4.6's agentic coding capabilities in real-world scenarios, we developed CC-Bench-V1.1 using Claude Code as the agentic coding testbed. Building on CC-Bench-V1.0, we added 22 more challenging coding tasks and conducted comprehensive evaluations against Claude-Sonnet-4, GLM-4.5, Kimi-K2-0905, and DeepSeek-V3.1-Terminus. The benchmark comprises 74 coding tasks spanning frontend development, tool development, data analysis, testing, and… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/ManuelZnnmc/CC-Bench-trajectories.
reputation: A recent, specialized benchmark created to evaluate agentic coding capabilities on challenging, real-world coding tasks; adoption is currently limited outside the authors' evaluations.
